eq.auto_trim_desc: Attenuates the output by whatever the equaliser adds. Turning it off makes boosts really louder, at the risk of clipping.
eq.profile_docked_desc: Audio goes to a TV or an amplifier, which usually needs nothing.
eq.profile_handheld_desc: Built-in speakers produce nothing below 250 Hz and distort when fed bass. This profile also applies to headphones (jack, USB or Bluetooth) used in handheld mode.
eq.q_desc: The higher the value, the narrower the correction.
eq.adjust_desc: Five vertical faders under the curve they produce.
eq.reset_desc: Replaces the five bands with the handheld profile.

gestures.title: Touch gestures
gestures.subtitle: What each touchscreen gesture does
gestures.double_auto_desc: Repeats the single tap — the click fires immediately
gestures.double_latency_desc: Own action: the single tap waits 0.4 s to see if a double follows

hud.latency_silent: no sample in the last window

menu.apply_desc: Resends the bitrate to the running session. Frame rate and resolution wait for the next connection.
menu.applied_bitrate: Bitrate resent to the session: {} Mb/s
menu.apply_audio_desc: Re-applies volume and equaliser to the running session. The codec waits for the next connection.
menu.audio_quality_desc: High fidelity = lossless FLAC (~900 kbit/s instead of ~100). Takes effect on next connection.
menu.bitrate_desc: Applied immediately. Changes whichever setting governs the running session.
menu.eq_profile_desc: Applies to the console's current mode — in handheld, headphones included.
menu.fps_desc: The server treats this as a maximum. It applies at the next connection
menu.hint_nav: Up/Down: move    Left/Right: adjust    A: select    B: {}
menu.hw_audio_next: Takes effect next time you connect. Compare on the same scene.
menu.mouse_relative_desc: Sends relative motion. Turn on whenever a game captures the mouse — otherwise it flies off. Leave off on the desktop.
menu.pad_deadzone_desc: Too low and the character drifts; too high and small movements are ignored.
menu.pad_invert_y_desc: Swaps up and down on both sticks.
menu.resolution_desc: Takes effect on the next connection
menu.resolution_next: Applies next time you connect: the server does not renegotiate resolution mid-session.
menu.scroll_invert_desc: Two-finger swipe up scrolls down the page (Windows touchpad habit)
menu.title: Menu
menu.touch_desc: Relative: slide like a trackpad. Absolute: the pointer goes where you touch. Taps and gestures are set in Settings › Controls.
menu.touch_sens_desc: How far the pointer travels for the same gesture. Drop to 20-35 % to aim in a game.
menu.ui_scale_desc: Magnification of the panel and menus
menu.volume_desc: Above 100% the sound is boosted; loud passages will clip.
menu.edit_pos_desc: Closes this menu and enters arrange mode: drag blocks with your finger, bring two close to snap them together, long-press a block to detach it. Hold Start to confirm.
menu.reset_pos_desc: Back to the default layout, stacked on the right.
menu.dbg_replug_desc: Sends the plug-in announcement to the VM again
menu.dbg_idr_desc: Forces the server to send a full picture
menu.dbg_refresh_desc: What the official client sends on resize
menu.opacity_desc: From 10 to 100%. Applies to the whole block, text included.
menu.pad_mouse_desc: The Joy-Cons drive the mouse. Shortcut: click BOTH sticks at once (L3+R3).
menu.pad_mouse_mode_desc: Sticks: steady, needs no room. Gyroscope: far more precise for aiming.
menu.pad_mouse_sens_desc: ZR = left click, ZL = right click, R = middle click, left stick = wheel.
menu.pad_mouse_test_desc: Pointer, sensors and buttons, in figures. Sends NOTHING to the remote machine.
menu.pm_hint: X recentres the pointer  -  hold {} to leave
menu.pad_mouse_gyro_src_desc: Both Joy-Cons have a gyroscope. The paired modes need a detached pair.
menu.pad_mouse_group_desc: Pointing with the Joy-Cons: mode, sensor, sensitivity, test.
menu.dbg_sftp_files_desc: Opens the folder holding this session's SFTP credential and the explanation of what it is. Have it written first with SHADOW_FT_REVEAL=1 in env.txt. Careful: WinSCP and FileZilla cannot use it — the password is 395 bytes with newlines in it, which a password box cannot carry. It needs a library (libssh), or a client that reads the password from a file.

pad.intro: Each console button is sent to Shadow as the button shown next to it. Left/Right to change.
pad.test_desc: Compares what the console reads with what we send. If they differ, the fault is ours.
pad.title: Gamepad
pad.type_desc: What the VM believes it sees. Xbox 360 (XInput) works with the most Windows games. Takes effect next session.
pad.rumble_low_desc: Deep rumble at full power. Bypasses the protocol: if nothing happens, the fault is hardware, not network.
pad.rumble_intensity_desc: Applies to games and to the tests below. At « Off » the motors stay silent.
pad.rumble_stop_desc: The protocol carries no duration: a rumble holds until stopped.
pad.rear_desc: The four buttons this console does not have, on the panel your fingers already rest on
pad.rear_on_desc: Off by default: it changes what the pad sends
pad.rear_zone_desc: The quarter of the panel, seen from behind
pad.rear_two_desc: Two contacts landing together, wherever they land
pad.rear_slide_desc: How far a finger travels to reach the end of an analog trigger
pad.rear_test_desc: what the panel reads, and what each zone sends
pad.rear_off_hint: Off — switch it on in the gamepad settings

quality.title: Stream quality
quality.subtitle: Advanced settings
quality.tip: A higher bitrate improves the picture but needs a better connection. “Auto” lets Shadow decide.
quality.bitrate_desc: Cap requested from the server, which treats it as a MAXIMUM, not a target. ⚠ Above about 25 Mb/s the picture degrades in play on a console over Wi-Fi.
quality.fps_desc: Beyond what the screen shows, the surplus is encoded for nothing. Takes effect on the next connection.
quality.resolution_desc: The built-in screen is 1280x720: asking for more in handheld encodes twice the pixels for nothing.
quality.codec_desc: H.264 and H.265 both work end to end; H.265 needs less bitrate for the same picture. AV1 is allowed by the account but has never been verified, and the Switch has no hardware AV1 decoding. Takes effect on next connection.
quality.profile_desc: Speed favours latency, Quality favours the picture.
quality.vsync_desc: ON (default): the picture only changes between refreshes, no visible break. OFF: it changes as soon as it is ready — about 8 ms less waiting, but a tear line may show during fast motion. Applies to the stream only, not the menus. Takes effect on next connection.
quality.chroma444_desc: Full-resolution chroma: sharper text, but decoding falls back to SOFTWARE and the bitrate rises sharply. Takes effect on next connection.
quality.chroma444_switch: Unavailable on Switch — the Tegra X1 hardware decoder handles 4:4:4 on no codec, and software cannot keep up.
quality.bitrate_overridden: No effect: "Bitrate per link" is on and decides instead (Settings > Video).
quality.mode_fixed: Fixed by this console: the panel is 960x544 at 60 Hz, and the hardware decoder picks its geometry by what it can allocate.
quality.codec_fixed: H.264. This console's hardware decoder does not do HEVC.

settings.auto_connect_desc: Connects on its own when the account has a single machine. Turn off to reach the settings.
settings.auto_res_desc: 1080p docked, 720p handheld — the built-in screen goes no higher.
settings.dev_channel_desc: Lets a computer on the network read the log and take screenshots. No effect if no destination is configured.
settings.dev_channel_now_desc: Attempts the connection without restarting. The computer must be listening.
settings.eq_desc: Tonal correction of the machine's audio, with docked and handheld profiles.
settings.focus_cut_desc: The HOME menu and sleep end the session. Keeping it is a gamble: the console may stop us anyway.
settings.gestures_desc: Tap, double tap, long press, multi-finger shortcuts
settings.hw_audio_desc: A few percent of one core, paid for with a round trip per packet. Measure before keeping.
settings.hw_video_desc: Much lighter on the console. Falls back to software on failure.
settings.log_desc: What the app writes to the SD card. Higher means more detail and more writes.
settings.logout_desc: Clears the saved token and quits the app
settings.logout_question: Sign out of this Shadow account?
settings.pad_enable_desc: Announces a gamepad to the remote machine. Some games then ignore keyboard and mouse.
settings.rate_link_desc: Separate settings for Wi-Fi and the dock's Ethernet. Overrides the Quality screen's bitrate.
settings.reco_desc: Restarts on its own when the stream dies unexpectedly.
settings.reg_input_desc: Experiment: may make the remote machine see a gamepad. Check mouse and keyboard still work.
settings.restart_needed: Restart the app to change language
settings.sounds_desc: Small audio feedback on navigation, confirmation and settings. Muted during streaming.
settings.sound_volume_desc: Separate from the game volume. Changing it plays a sample.
settings.title: Settings
settings.about_date_desc: UTC time this binary was compiled
settings.about_hash_desc: The commit it was built from — quote it in a report
settings.log_size_desc: {} files of the {} kept — {} for the current session
settings.log_view_desc: The last lines of the current session
settings.log_clear_desc: Empties the current session and deletes the archives
settings.log_clear_question: Clear every log? The record of what just happened will be lost.
settings.haptics_desc: Short vibration on limits, toggles and mode changes. 0% turns it off. No effect during streaming, where the remote machine already drives the motors.
settings.time_today_desc: Counted by this console only — a session started from a PC or the browser is not included.
settings.time_month_desc: Reset when the month changes. This is not Shadow's own count: if they bill machine-on time, the two will differ.
settings.time_total_desc: Since the first session on this console.
settings.replay_desc: Back to the boot screen without closing the window. The session stays: this replays loading, not pairing.
settings.replay_auth_desc: Same, but forgets the token: the pairing code comes back. Handy to record the whole journey in one take.
settings.pointer_desc: Replaces the cursor with a dot that marks clicks, with a ripple that stays visible for half a second. So recordings show the gesture, not just its result. Desktop only.
settings.cursor_desc: Which pointer to draw over the stream. The remote machine usually composites its own into the picture; in full screen or in a game, it composites none.
settings.clipboard_desc: Which way the clipboard is shared with the remote machine. What you copy on one side becomes pasteable on the other. One way protects what must not leave: otherwise anything copied on Shadow lands in this PC’s clipboard, where any other application can read it. Leaving “Off” needs a reconnection.
settings.rate_wifi_desc: Cap requested from the server on Wi-Fi. High values have never been validated in-game: see the warning on the Ethernet rate.
settings.rate_eth_desc: Cap requested from the server on Ethernet. ⚠ Above ~25 Mb/s the picture degrades in play on console (artefacts, the previous frame persisting): 100 Mb/s breaks, 25 Mb/s holds.
settings.video_tcp_desc: The official client's "reliability" profile: no loss, but the server's ADAPTIVE BITRATE is turned off. Takes effect on the next connection.
settings.forced_env: ⚠ Forced by env.txt ({}) — what you see here is not what is running.
settings.env_over_desc: Variables dropped on the SD card that override the settings on this screen.
settings.reset_desc: Puts everything back to its original value. Play time counted is kept.
settings.reset_confirm: Reset every setting to its original value?
settings.stretch_desc: Fills the whole screen instead of keeping the aspect ratio. Removes the black bars, distorts the picture.
settings.lock_state_desc: A code is asked for at launch. Protects access from this console - not the files on the SD card, which stay readable from a computer.
settings.lock_state_off_desc: No code is asked for. Pick a method below to turn the lock on.
settings.lock_pattern_desc: A path across a 3x3 grid, with a finger or with the D-pad.
settings.lock_password_desc: 4 to 63 characters, typed on the system keyboard (masked).
settings.lock_wake_desc: Asks for the code again after sleep or a trip through the HOME menu. Without it the lock is only asked for at launch.
settings.lock_remove_desc: Removes every method at once. The application will open without asking anything.
settings.about_tag_desc: The git tag this build was made from, when it is exactly on one
settings.about_license_desc: This program is free software. The complete source, including every library it links, is published under this licence.
settings.about_source_desc: Where to get the source code corresponding to this exact build
settings.about_author_desc: Unofficial client, not affiliated with Shadow, Nintendo or Sony. Connecting with it may breach Shadow's terms of service and put your account at risk. No warranty (GPL-3.0 §15-16).
settings.net_family_desc: Which address family to reach the remote machine with. Automatic tries both, one after the other: if your network blocks one, half of every attempt is spent waiting on an address that will never answer (measured here: 8.6 s lost on one start-up, where the working one answered in 22 ms). Only force one if you know which works: forcing the wrong one prevents any connection. Takes effect on the next connection.

net.title: Link quality
net.subtitle: Measured on the running stream - nothing is sent for this test
net.caveat: The round trip is measured on the control channel (TCP), not on the video path (UDP): they can differ. The loss rate is a lower bound - a frame whose first chunk is missing is counted nowhere but in the line below it.
net.menu_desc: Carried bitrate, round trip and loss - measured on the running stream.
